module.purpose: Provides utilities for deriving stable edge marker identifiers and collecting deduplicated marker properties for graph rendering.
module.summary: This module normalizes marker definitions into deterministic identifiers by handling absent, string, and object markers. It also scans edge endpoints, applies default marker settings, deduplicates object markers, preserves marker colors with fallback defaults, and returns marker properties sorted by identifier.
module.businessContext: Supports visual graph edge rendering by managing reusable start and end markers. Failures could produce missing, duplicated, or inconsistently ordered edge marker definitions.
functions: getMarkerId (~L3-19): Builds stable identifiers from string or object marker definitions.
createMarkerIds (~L21-51): Collects, deduplicates, and sorts marker properties for edges.

detail.name: getMarkerId
detail.signature: export function getMarkerId(marker: EdgeMarkerType | undefined, id?: string | null): string
preconditions: marker is undefined, a string, or an object compatible with EdgeMarkerType.
postconditions: Returns an empty string when marker is absent.
For a string marker, returns the marker unchanged.
For an object marker, serializes its own enumerable keys in sorted order as key=value pairs joined by ampersands.
For an object marker and a truthy id, prefixes the serialization with id followed by two underscores.
invariants: Object marker key ordering in the result is lexicographic according to JavaScript's Array.sort behavior.
The id prefix is omitted when id is undefined, null, or otherwise falsy.
edgeCases: An undefined marker returns an empty string regardless of id.
A string marker returns unchanged, and id does not affect the result.
An empty object produces an empty string, or id followed by two underscores when id is truthy.
Object keys are sorted before serialization, so insertion order does not determine the output.
detail.ioFormatSpec: For object markers: [optional id + "__"] followed by sorted own enumerable keys serialized as key=value and joined with "&". String markers pass through unchanged.
detail.summary: Returns a stable marker identifier from a marker value. String markers are returned unchanged, while object markers are serialized from sorted keys and may be prefixed by a truthy id.

specLiterals.role: Separates a truthy id prefix from an object marker serialization.
Separates each serialized marker key from its value.

specTests.then: The result is the empty string.

detail.signature: createMarkerIds(edges: EdgeBase[], { id, defaultColor, defaultMarkerStart, defaultMarkerEnd }: { id?: string | null; defaultColor?: string | null; defaultMarkerStart?: EdgeMarkerType; defaultMarkerEnd?: EdgeMarkerType }): MarkerProps[]

parameters.name: { id, defaultColor, defaultMarkerStart, defaultMarkerEnd }
parameters.type: { id?: string | null; defaultColor?: string | null; defaultMarkerStart?: EdgeMarkerType; defaultMarkerEnd?: EdgeMarkerType }

preconditions: The edges argument is an array of EdgeBase values.
The options argument is an object whose marker defaults conform to the declared EdgeMarkerType and color/id types.
postconditions: Returns an array containing at most one entry for each generated marker ID.
Each accepted marker contributes a MarkerProps object containing the marker data and generated marker ID unless those fields are overridden by the marker object spread.
The returned array is sorted by marker ID using localeCompare.
invariants: A marker ID is added to the result only once during processing.
Each edge contributes its start marker before its end marker.
Only truthy marker values that are objects are processed.
edgeCases: An empty edges array returns an empty array.
A missing or falsy edge marker uses the corresponding default marker; if both are falsy, no marker is added.
Non-object or falsy marker values are ignored.
Markers producing the same generated marker ID are deduplicated, retaining the first encountered result before final sorting.
A marker color is initially selected from marker.color or defaultColor, while properties supplied by the marker object can override the constructed id and color during object spreading.
detail.summary: Builds a sorted collection of unique marker property objects from edge start and end markers, applying configured marker fallbacks and default color values.
